referenceSources.title: DTM-Classic Lausitzring, Rosberg-Opel bringt V6-Sound
referenceSources.description:
A meticulously restored Opel Calibra V6 stands ready in a garage, its yellow-and-white paint scheme and period sponsor logos—Mannesmann, Mobil 1, Minichamps, Baumler, Bosch, Dekra—faithfully recreated. This car, last raced in the 1995 DTM season by 1982 F1 World Champion Keke Rosberg, boasts a 2.5‑liter V6 engine developed with Williams and Cosworth, delivering over 500 PS and a signature high‑revving roar.

Mücke Motorsport’s Classic division has returned the Calibra to its original condition for the DTM Classic Cup at the Lausitzring (May 20–22). Stefan Mücke will pilot this car, while Ronny Scheer takes the wheel of a second Calibra. Fans can admire both the visual authenticity and the legendary V6 sound during the weekend’s races.
